```dockerfile

ENV CFLAGS "-I/usr/include/openssl11"
ENV CPPFLAGS "-I/usr/include/openssl11"
ENV LDFLAGS "-L/usr/lib64/openssl11"
```
This lets pyenv build Python 3.10+ against OpenSSL 1.1 on CentOS 7 (whose system OpenSSL is 1.0.2). It only fires for CentOS 7 — Ubuntu Dockerfiles are unaffected (verified).
